cSPACE Marda Loop

A place for creative boundary crossings

Arts-centered and community-driven, cSPACE Marda Loop is an innovative creative hub, coworking and event venue. A place where visitors engage with diverse arts and culture programming, performances and inspiring artist studios. Enjoy the fully accessible facility with onsite café, free exhibition and craft galleries, and stunning public art works. Within a reimagined historic sandstone school, come explore how creativity thrives in vibrant communities.

Tonight is the Final Exhibition and Time Capsule Celebration of the @workingmotherexperience

This is a collaboration with cSPACE MARDA LOOP Tenant @prospectartservices in their Studio C Gallery. This gallery space inside cSPACE is open to the public and often features works from their art-based programming or collaborations like this with the @workingmotherexperience that aim to amplify underrepresented voices in gallery spaces.

Come explore this gallery, on until May 1, and see the unique works that emerged through reflections on the lived experiences of motherhood.

There are still tickets to join the celebration event tonight in the Studio Theatre at cSPACE MARDA LOOP featuring speakers, artists and thoughtful guest activities. Head to the linked profiles for more information.

Open post by cspace.mardaloop with ID 17939451426198373

What does it look like to be a part of our cSPACE community? Creativity and collaboration to name a few!

Meet @lanaskauge a local performer and published author. On April 26 she is hosting a book launch for her new book, Made of Snow and Story.

But she didn’t get here alone. cSPACE creates the conditions for collaboration and Lana’s story is a prime example. She has been ingrained in our community since the very beginning nearly 10 years ago. Through her involvement with cSPACE tenant @alexandrawriters she was able to grow as a writer and develop long lasting links in the writers community. Lifelong friend @dougyyc of @mdgyyc - another cSPACE tenant - has led to even more creative connections, with Doug designing the poster layout (and Lana’s logo) for her book launch event.

This story highlights the magic of cSPACE. Turning space into place. A place to activate people and ideas to ignite collaboration and community-led change.
